robotBrokeDescription: Extendo hopper broke at 1:27 on the continuous match clock (1:24 in the source notes). They went to pick up fuel from under the blue trench and the hopper caught. The damage reduced fuel capacity and caused fuel to leak out. It seemed easily repairable; another opponent got caught on the same trench this match.
notes: They briefly got caught in defense by 4451 but appeared confident they could escape; it took a moment. They have a strong, well-trained drive team and led the alliance. They seem to prefer shooting from within the trench, even when picking up fuel inside their alliance zone.
